posts.title: My personal AI assistant today: ~170 tools, any client, Hermes as the daily driver
posts.description: My AI assistant is one backend with ~170 tools, used from Hermes, Claude Code or Claude Desktop. Here’s what it does, why one backend is worth it, and where Hermes fits in.

posts.title: How the architect talks to the engineer
posts.description: The architect and the engineer never share a context window. Here’s the protocol that lets them work together anyway: a handoff comment in Linear, ADRs for anything durable, and a status field that says whose move it is.

posts.title: The engineer gets its own machine
posts.description: The architect/engineer split from the last post became an actual CLI, and the engineer role moved off my laptop onto a machine of its own.
